newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent closes 12 cents down, caution over APIs.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent closes 12 cents down, caution over APIs.

text.p: IPE Brent crude futures last traded 12 cents down on Tuesday in thin, nervous activity that never fully recovered from a NYMEX-inspired, mid-afternoon slump, traders said.

Feb Brent finished at $23.36 a barrel, 16 cents off the intra-day low of $23.20, overshadowed by weaker NYMEX gasoline and amid caution inspired by the release later on Tuesday of American Petroleum Institute inventory data.
"With the APIs coming out people are too scared to really do anything," a trader said.
"It's just been locals trying to make a penny here and there," another said.

Minutes before its mid-afternoon slump to $23.20, Brent had traded at a session high of $23.55 on the back of an aborted upside break by NYMEX crude and products. Then a technical sell-off on NYMEX triggered aggressive long liquidation and shunted London lower.
Feb IPE gas oil settled down $5.25 at $213.75 a tonne and just off the low of $213.50.
NYMEX gasoline steepened losses in late session amid position squaring ahead of API inventory data expected to show a bearish increase in gasoline stocks.
